meta.name: Feludar Goyendagiri
meta.description:
In the exquisite but bloodied snowscape of Kashmir, Feluda, Topshe, and Jatayu encounter a chilling mystery as a retired judge is murdered. Now Feluda has to navigate multiple suspects and political tension to uncover the truth.

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 not on server | S3 not on server

videos.title: Dhundhumar Darjeeling
videos.overview: Feluda, Topshe and Lalmohan reach Darjeeling on Pulak Ghoshal's invitation. The trio meet Birupakkho Majumdar during a stroll in the Darjeeling Mall.

videos.title: Birupakkho Brittanto
videos.overview: Birupakhkho Majumdar reveals some uncanny facts about his life. Pulak Ghoshal makes Lalmohan an unusual but tempting offer.

videos.title: Shooting-ey Shihoron
videos.overview: During the shooting, Lalmohan overhears Birupakhkho berating someone. The next day, a piece of news leaves the trio in shock.

videos.title: Taalmaatal Tawdonto
videos.overview: Feluda detects some crucial clues at the crime scene and also gets to know about Birupakhkho's dark past. An unknown man pushes Feluda off a cliff.

videos.title: Himalaye Hotyakando
videos.overview: Birupakhkho's former doctor reveals the strained relationships in the Majumdar family. While Feluda interrogates the suspects, Topshe and Lalmohan discover something startling in the jungle.

videos.title: Jawmjawmat Jawbonika
videos.overview: Feluda rounds up all those with both motive and opportunity for murder and unmasks everyone one by one.
